Today, Hutchinson Builders is a 100% Australian-owned company with offices nationwide. We've delivered iconic projects like the Howard Smith Wharves and the Hutchinson Builders Centre of Excellence, always staying true to our roots in South Melbourne.

Our team of over 2,000 skilled professionals brings decades of combined experience to every project. We're proud to be a family-run business that treats every client like a neighbour, with honesty and respect.

blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Commercial Fit-Out Cost in South Melbourne in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: A detailed breakdown of commercial fit-out costs in South Melbourne, including office, retail, and warehouse spaces. Get realistic budgets for your project.
body: Planning a commercial fit-out in South Melbourne? Costs vary widely depending on the size, scope, and finish level of your project. On average, you can expect to pay between $1,500 and $4,000 per square metre for a basic to premium fit-out. Factors like structural changes, HVAC upgrades, and heritage requirements can push costs higher.

South Melbourne's commercial precinct is booming, with demand for modern office spaces and retail fit-outs on the rise. The City of Port Phillip council has specific guidelines for heritage buildings, which may require additional approvals and specialised trades. Always factor in a 10-15% contingency for unexpected issues.

A basic fit-out for a small office might cost around $150,000, while a full-scale retail fit-out with custom joinery and lighting can exceed $500,000. Warehouse conversions are often more affordable, starting from $800 per square metre. Hutchinson Builders provides fixed-price quotes so you know exactly what you're paying.

Timing is another key factor. Most commercial fit-outs in South Melbourne take 8 to 16 weeks, depending on complexity. Delays can occur if you need council permits or if materials are back-ordered. We recommend starting the planning process at least 3 months before your desired move-in date.

Choosing the right builder is crucial. Look for a team with local experience, like Hutchinson Builders, who understand South Melbourne's council requirements and have strong relationships with local suppliers. This can save you time and money on your fit-out.

Finally, don't forget about sustainability. Many South Melbourne businesses are opting for Green Star-rated fit-outs to reduce energy costs and attract eco-conscious clients. Features like LED lighting, efficient HVAC, and recycled materials can qualify for government rebates and improve your bottom line.

blogPosts.title: Top 5 Things to Know Before Building a Home in South Melbourne
blogPosts.excerpt: Thinking of building a new home in South Melbourne? Here are five essential tips on council rules, soil conditions, and choosing the right builder.
body: Building a new home in South Melbourne is an exciting journey, but it comes with unique challenges. The area's mix of heritage overlays, narrow blocks, and high land values means you need a builder who knows the local landscape. Here are five things to consider before you start.

First, check the zoning and heritage status of your block. South Melbourne has several heritage precincts that restrict what you can build. You may need a heritage impact assessment and council approval for any changes to the facade. Hutchinson Builders can help navigate these requirements.

Second, understand the soil conditions. Much of South Melbourne sits on former swamp land, which means reactive clay soils that can shift with moisture. This requires specialised foundation designs, such as screw piles or waffle slabs, to prevent cracking. A soil test is essential before any design work.

Third, plan for parking and access. Many South Melbourne streets are narrow, and council may require on-site parking for new homes. If your block is small, consider a basement or car stacker. Also, factor in construction vehicle access, which can be tricky in tight laneways.

Fourth, budget for higher costs. Land in South Melbourne is among the most expensive in Melbourne, and construction costs are higher due to labour and material demands. A typical new home can cost $2,500 to $4,000 per square metre. Get a detailed quote from a local builder early.

Finally, choose a builder with local experience. Hutchinson Builders has been building in South Melbourne for over a century. We know the council, the subcontractors, and the best ways to deliver your dream home on time and on budget.

blogPosts.title: The Cost of Building a Warehouse in Port Melbourne in 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: A comprehensive guide to warehouse construction costs in Port Melbourne, including factors like size, height, and fit-out. Plan your budget with confidence.
body: Port Melbourne is a prime location for industrial and warehouse construction, thanks to its proximity to the port and major transport routes. Building a warehouse here in 2026 involves several cost factors, from land acquisition to fit-out. Here's what you need to know.

The average cost to build a warehouse in Port Melbourne ranges from $1,200 to $2,500 per square metre, depending on the size and specifications. A basic 2,000 square metre warehouse with a clear height of 10 metres might cost around $2.4 million, while a high-spec cold storage facility could exceed $5 million.

Key cost drivers include the type of cladding, insulation, and roofing. For cold storage, you'll need specialised insulated panels and refrigeration systems, which can add 30-50% to the base cost. Also, consider the floor loading capacity if you plan to use heavy machinery or racking systems.

Council approvals in Port Melbourne are generally straightforward for industrial zones, but you may need a planning permit if your site is near residential areas. Environmental assessments for stormwater management and contamination are also common. Factor in 8-12 weeks for approvals.

Timeline is another consideration. A standard warehouse build takes 6 to 12 months, depending on weather and material availability. Steel and concrete prices have stabilised in 2026, but it's wise to lock in prices early with your builder to avoid fluctuations.

Hutchinson Builders has extensive experience in industrial construction across Port Melbourne. We've delivered projects for clients like NewCold and Wallenius Wilhelmsen, ensuring quality, safety, and on-time delivery. Contact us for a free quote on your warehouse project.

blogPosts.title: How to Choose a Builder for Your South Melbourne Renovation
blogPosts.excerpt: Renovating in South Melbourne? Learn how to pick the right builder, what questions to ask, and how to avoid common pitfalls. Expert advice from Hutchinson Builders.
body: Renovating your home in South Melbourne can add value and comfort, but choosing the right builder is critical. With so many options, it's easy to feel overwhelmed. Here's a step-by-step guide to finding a builder who will deliver quality work without the stress.

Start by checking credentials. Your builder should be registered with the Victorian Building Authority (VBA) and have public liability insurance. Ask for references and visit past projects if possible. Hutchinson Builders has been registered and insured for over 100 years, giving you peace of mind.

Next, get multiple quotes. A detailed quote should include materials, labour, timelines, and a payment schedule. Be wary of quotes that are significantly lower than others — they may cut corners or add hidden costs later. A fixed-price contract is always best.

Communication is key. Choose a builder who listens to your ideas and provides clear answers. At Hutchinson Builders, we pride ourselves on our straight-talking approach. We'll keep you updated throughout the renovation, so there are no surprises.

Consider the scope of your renovation. A kitchen and bathroom remodel might take 6-8 weeks, while a full home renovation could take 4-6 months. Make sure your builder has the capacity to handle your project without delays. We manage our schedule carefully to stay on track.

Finally, trust your gut. If a builder seems pushy or vague, move on. The right builder will be transparent, professional, and passionate about your project. Hutchinson Builders is here to help you create the home you've always wanted in South Melbourne.
